reason: The bounded CSV parser example compiles and passes quoted fields, embedded commas, an empty field and doubled quotes. Deferred before publication: the manifest license is the placeholder "license", no repository license file was found, and the Fortran wrapper has no explicit license notice; only bundled C sources identify LGPL-2.1-or-later. Source review also finds incorrect unused C bindings: entry_buf is a character rather than a C pointer, csv_strerror returns a character rather than a C pointer, and csv_write/csv_write2 omit VALUE on pointer arguments. Author clarification and a binding review are needed before presenting this as a ready-to-use library.
